notes.title: Two small bug fixes and a Korean script update
notes.notes:
[b]Korean Language Script has been updated![/b]

[b]Bug Fix 1 [/b]: When learning the GEO song from Georgia, talking to her while she is whistling will cause the song to become unlearnable. This was previously worked around by exiting the room and talking to her again. With the new fix, talking to Georgia while she is whistling won't cause the song to be unlearnable.

[b]Bug Fix 2 [/b]: Mashing the text in Ouroboros Hideout may cause an Ouroboros Proof to not be given to players. With this new fix, even if this occurs, the player can still proceed through the boss door so long as the three trials are finished.

notes.title: Hotfix to revert change affecting RTA / speed running community
notes.notes: The change where the "[i]player is blocked from leaving until they also learn the song from Zeke[/i]" was reverted as to not adversely affect the RTA/speed running community.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 21st, 2021
notes.notes:
Game build is now updated to v1.2.7. The major wins for this update are script improvements, releasing of the soundtrack to the app store, and *almost* steam community items!

Major thanks to the "PLAY on Words" team for huge edits and polish to the Chinese script . See the detailed update notes of [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YGXD86y745rT-k0c8AgqJQ_BUWV9XND-XTk1AIPRVoQ/edit#gid=652520234]v1.2.7. here[/url].

The Steam soundtrack page can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1595840/Phoenotopia_Awakening_Soundtrack/]here[/url].

Lastly, community items are unfortunately still stuck undergoing Steam's review. I'm hopeful they can pass soon and be available within the next 1 or 2 days. Expect a more full announcement on that when they arrive.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2021 March 12
notes.notes:
The main feature of this update is that a MAC build is now available.

Other changes include:
- various fixes to levels (fixing various visual, tiling, and collision errors)
- ending credits song extended to last entirety of credits
- a few grating sound effects reworked
- slight updates to Chinese and English script

See more in-depth update notes here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YGXD86y745rT-k0c8AgqJQ_BUWV9XND-XTk1AIPRVoQ/edit#gid=939331021

notes.title: Experimental Branch Update
notes.notes: The "experimental branch" has now been updated to include the WIP Korean translation. (Note, It's also v.1.2.4 now)

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 23, 2021
notes.notes:
This update brings the game to version 1.2.3

- main character reworked to use a "variable" update step. This will improve general smoothness of the character and environment.
- when shooting crossbow with the mouse, if the player doesn't move, the subsequent crossbow shot will aim at the previous location
- Four graphical options now exist from the screen settings menu.
- notes from flute are correctly shifted one semi-tone up and down when holding left or right trigger
- some corrections to script for more clarity
- Ouroboros gates open more quickly

Read the full patch notes here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1YGXD86y745rT-k0c8AgqJQ_BUWV9XND-XTk1AIPRVoQ/edit#gid=939331021

notes.title: Update notes for FEB 10, 2021 (part 2)
notes.notes:
This mini-update locks the new "smooth follow" camera behind a screen setting option.

The old camera following behavior is used by default.

notes.title: Update Notes for FEB 10th, 2021
notes.notes:
- Changes the game's fixed time physics step from 1/50 of a second to 1/60 of a second to alleviate a skippiness problem experienced by some players
- Camera scrolling upgraded to feel more smooth
- fixes a text box issue where when playing with 1440p resolution, text box could appear off-screen
